CPU-ARC belongs in the Nov 9 supplement under its observed HF recommendation date; the other qualifying records have older source dates and remain labeled historical backlog. Eight older cases were also processed: six passed scope and qualitative-summary review, Evolver was excluded from Harness, and Cache Engineering still lacks specific evolution-version artifacts. The resulting 13 historical backlog decisions are recorded for this week, not counted as new papers today. Three arXiv searches succeeded with no window results; five RSS feeds returned 50 window records, and 13 GitHub repositories had no window releases. S2 citations returned 311 window records (278 unique identities); anonymous throttling and the 180-second source traversal window left parts of citation and author coverage uncollected. Uncollected coverage remains unknown. Sixteen free retries of eight older source blockers did not recover the required bodies. New paid generation requests: zero. This is a collection and review snapshot bulletin, not a new-paper edition or a claim that no later updates exist.
